tools.name: shell
tools.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, re
root=Path('<PRIVATE_RUN_ROOT>/zhice-runs/codex-plugin/workspace/outputs')
assert Path.cwd() == root.parent
knowledge_id='ds_b4cbf46595d98dd2a0e872c1d96bf03d'
documents=json.loads(\"{\\\"review.txt\\\":\\\"doc_46a23b2fb47ba47f3b8a9ef0195cc54a\\\",\\\"prd.txt\\\":\\\"doc_bc9879c116ae6e5b264200dc3f09378b\\\",\\\"design.txt\\\":\\\"doc_dbd6a8d75dba652c433795dee8d095cc\\\",\\\"handoff.txt\\\":\\\"doc_fee089df8b540192144ac3cf56ac4cec\\\"}\")
base='http://127.0.0.1:8091'
notice='> 来源链接审核后恢复（2026-10-14）：初次输出将下载路径错误拼接为网页链接；本版仅修正来源链接及其说明，保留初次文件，正文事实不变。本轮通过 LazyMind knowledge.document.list 核对文档名称与实际 ID。新网页链接由协调者浏览器验收（据本轮用户提供的验收结果）；需要本地服务和登录，不是公开链接，助手本轮未亲自打开。正文保留的检索、全文读取及工具记录属于原始写作轮次，不表示本轮重新执行。\\n\\n'
link_note='以上来源网页链接已按核对的知识库 ID 和文档 ID 修正，由协调者浏览器验收；需要本地服务和登录，不是公开链接，助手本轮未亲自打开。'
changes={
 '01-summary.md':[
  ('工具返回的来源下载链接','来源网页链接（协调者浏览器验收）'),
  ('以上链接由工具返回的相对 "'`download_url` 按配置的 LazyMind 基址 `http://127.0.0.1:8091` 补全，保留原路径；本次没有另行点击下载验证。'"',link_note)
 ],
 '02-scope-evidence.md':[
  ('工具来源链接','来源网页链接（协调者浏览器验收）'),
  ('来源链接保留工具返回的下载路径，并以配置的 LazyMind 基址补全；未另行点击下载核验。',link_note)
 ]
}
prepared=[]
for name, replacements in changes.items():
 source=root/name
 original_bytes=source.read_bytes()
 original=original_bytes.decode('utf-8')
 target=root/(source.stem+'-reviewed.md')
 assert not target.exists(), f'拒绝覆盖已有文件：{target}'
 revised=original
 counts={}
 for document_name,document_id in documents.items():
  old=f'{base}/datasets/{knowledge_id}/documents/{document_id}:download'
  new=f'{base}/lib/knowledge/knowledge/{knowledge_id}/{document_id}'
  counts[document_name]=revised.count(old)
  revised=revised.replace(old,new)
 assert '/datasets/' not in revised and ':download' not in revised
 for old,new in replacements:
  assert revised.count(old)==1, (name,old)
  revised=revised.replace(old,new,1)
 title,remaining=revised.split('\\n\\n',1)
 revised=title+'\\n\\n'+notice+remaining
 # Reverse all allowed edits to prove no other text changed.
 restored=revised.replace(notice,'',1)
 for old,new in reversed(replacements):
  assert restored.count(new)==1
  restored=restored.replace(new,old,1)
 for document_name,document_id in documents.items():
  old=f'{base}/datasets/{knowledge_id}/documents/{document_id}:download'
  new=f'{base}/lib/knowledge/knowledge/{knowledge_id}/{document_id}'
  restored=restored.replace(new,old)
 assert restored==original, '检测到链接与说明之外的变化'
 prepared.append((source,target,original_bytes,revised,counts))
for source,target,original_bytes,revised,counts in prepared:
 with target.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='') as output:
  output.write(revised)
 assert target.read_bytes()==revised.encode('utf-8')
 assert source.read_bytes()==original_bytes, '原文件发生变化'
 print(json.dumps({'file':target.name,'replacements':counts,'total':sum(counts.values()),'original_sha256':hashlib.sha256(original_bytes).hexdigest(),'original_unchanged':True,'only_allowed_edits':True},ensure_ascii=False))

PY"
